messages:
anya: Quick prioritization ask — ACME (big compliance deal) needs Private or they walk. Sales says close timeline end-of-month. I want to propose a pragmatic path: Dedicated GA first + a tiny Private Pilot that reuses Dedicated infra. Can we agree on gates?

jordan: Can you paste a quick RICE so we can see ordering?

anya: Putting a fast RICE below (very rough):
```
Option | Reach | Impact | Confidence | Effort (pts) | RICE
Dedicated GA      | 40 | 7 | 0.8 | 8  | 28.0
Private Minimal   | 2  | 9 | 0.5 | 6  | 1.5
Private Pilot (reuse Dedicated) | 4 | 8 | 0.6 | 3  | 6.4
```
Notes: Reach = estimated number of deals this quarter that could convert; Effort is team-pt scale.

kevin: Effort for Private Pilot at 3 pts is optimistic. KMS integration + audit delivery + secure deploy are non-trivial — I'd budget 6-8 hidden pts. Confidence should be lower until we spike KMS.

tess: Also worth a sensitivity check: ACME alone is ~500k ARR. If we weight impact by deal ARR, Private becomes much more attractive for that scenario.

sophie: Confirmed — ACME is a hard requirement. They gave us EOM as a deadline. Sales can accept a Pilot SOW and conditional MSA if we can deliver KMS + audit proof and a 30-day pilot SLA. I can own the SOW.

jordan: Technical thought: we can implement Pilot as an isolation shim on top of Dedicated instances: network isolation (VPC), secrets proxy for KMS, and audit hook to push logs to customer's SIEM. That avoids full on-prem provisioning. Migration path to full Private should be state-preserving.

anya: Proposed sequencing: 1) Ship Dedicated GA (highest reach) with a clear SLA; 2) Run 4-6 week Private Pilot for ACME that reuses Dedicated infra. Pilot launch criteria (all must pass): KMS integration validated, audit logs delivered to customer SIEM, 7-day stability at expected pilot QPS, signed pilot SOW. If pilot passes, expand scope to full Private.

kevin: Implementation red flags: storage tenancy assumptions, audit log throughput, and key rotation semantics. I'll run a 3-day spike to validate KMS + audit delivery. If spike succeeds we can drop Pilot engineering estimate to ~3-4 pts.

tess: I'll produce a confidence-sensitivity brief that shows how ACME ARR changes the RICE ordering and recommend a hedged approach.

sophie: I'll draft the Pilot SOW template and ping legal for an expedited MSA clause. If legal agrees to a conditional pilot clause I can lock ACME.

deploy-bot: RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfc/812 "Dedicated-first + ACME Pilot path" (owner: anya)

jordan: One more note: if Pilot requires >2 infra changes we should schedule sequential work. If it's limited to config + secrets + network, we can run in parallel.

anya: Action items: @jordan draft Dedicated GA SLA by Tue EOD; @kevin run KMS+audit spike (3 days) and update effort estimate; @tess run ARR-weighted RICE sensitivity; @sophie draft SOW + legal contact. Reconvene Wed 10:00 to lock priority. Thanks! :thumbsup:
